candidates.headline: SE Fruits & Vegetables secures PSX approval for IPO to raise up to Rs1.92bn
candidates.summary: Sargodha-based fruit/vegetable exporter SE Fruits & Vegetables Limited (formerly Shaheen Enterprises) received PSX approval on Sept 7, 2026 to offer 30 million ordinary shares (32.01% of post-IPO capital) via book-building, floor price Rs40/share, max price Rs64/share, to raise Rs1.2bn-Rs1.92bn; lead managers Topline Securities and Growth Securities. Not yet a listed constituent of the desk universe. Logged as impact 2 (minor company item - pre-listing IPO approval), per desk criteria Rule 10.
